en.title: Counting Strict Suffix Maxima in Fixed-Length Windows
en.description:
For each contiguous window of length k, count the positions that are strictly greater than every later element in the window, then add these counts over all windows. The last position of a window counts because it has no later element.

Added by this site: the first line of standard input contains n k and the second line contains n integers; 1≤n≤200000, 1≤k≤n, −10^9≤products[i]≤10^9. The original source did not preserve these ranges or the input/output protocol.
en.input:

en.explanation: See the companion notes for the correctness proof.
hints: Maintain the indices of the strict suffix maxima of the current window.
A new value evicts every value at the back of the queue that is not greater than it; the last position of the window also counts.
Equal values must be handled with a strict comparison.
